summary: Founder-run coater (30 staff, EUR 2-5 M), sole source of our cover plate set. In financial distress: credit index jumped 248 to 343, rating downgraded, bank watching monthly, MD 'cannot sign anything that lowers our margin now'. Complains about overdue invoices. Quality is red and worsening (OTD 54 %, 5556 ppm, 3 open 8D). Open moderate: buy price with faster payment, use the scorecard, do not squeeze it into failure.
notes: Needs cash: asked twice for earlier payment, quote remark requests 10-day payment. Fears the bank and late payers. Contradiction: says we pay late, yet we paid 6.7 days early on average taking 42 cash discounts; still 39 % of invoices over 5 days late. Contract already has 2 %/10 days. Sole source: supply risk if it fails.
